about: Guess the hip hop artist. Five clues each, hardest first; 5 points down to 1.

clues: Born in East Harlem and raised in Baltimore, he studied acting before his family moved west.
He joined a Bay Area group as a dancer and roadie before stepping up to the mic.
His 1996 double album topped the US chart and included a track sampling a Bruce Hornsby piano hook.
He was shot in Las Vegas in September 1996 and died in hospital days later.
The artist is 2Pac.
He grew up in Brooklyn's Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood and got his nickname from a local figure.
A 1994 debut, recorded after he was released on bail, became a multi-platinum classic.
He was shot in Los Angeles in March 1997, months after a posthumous double album appeared.
His 1997 single 'Hypnotize' topped the Hot 100 and sampled an Herb Alpert trumpet line.
The artist is The Notorious B.I.G., also known as Biggie Smalls.
He grew up in the Queensbridge housing projects and is the son of jazz musician Olu Dara.
A 1994 debut, heavily bootlegged before release, is often called one of the greatest rap albums ever.
He settled a very public New York feud in a 2001 track built from a Gil Scott-Heron loop.
He later released a sequel to that debut with a cover showing him beside a famous 1970s car.
The artist is Nas.
Before music he sold CDs out of a car in Brooklyn and sampled a rock band on an early single.
He co-founded Roc-A-Fella Records after major labels passed on him.
He married a global pop superstar and their daughter is named Blue Ivy.
His 2003 album featured a Nina Simone sample and a track built on a Rick James riff.
The artist is Jay-Z.
He was born in Missouri and raised in a trailer park near Detroit's 8 Mile Road.
He worked as a cook before a comedy-club open mic and a freestyle contest launched his career.
His alter ego first appeared on a 1997 independent album, then on a major-label debut produced by Dr. Dre.
He won an Academy Award for a song from a film about a Detroit rap battle.
The artist is Eminem.
He grew up in Queens and began rapping over beats from his grandfather's amplifier.
He was among the first rap acts signed to Def Jam and released a debut album in 1985.

His hits include a duet with Jennifer Lopez and the track 'Mama Said Knock You Out'.
The artist is LL Cool J.

One member was killed outside a New York recording studio in 2002.
The artist is Run-DMC.

Their producer later built a studio empire and launched the careers of a Detroit rapper and a Long Beach rapper.
